purpose: Regression fixture for a one-color standalone fondant bridal dress that was incorrectly inferred to be a complex bride figurine.
observed_construction: one visibly white molded fondant dress
ruffles and flowing fabric folds only
no visible head, torso, arms, legs, face, or complete human figure anatomy
non_qualifying_inference: A bridal/wedding theme, nearby text, a topper name, or a flowing dress description does not establish a bride figurine.
qualifying_counterexample: A complete freestanding human figure with visible all-around depth and modeled head, torso, limbs, face, or pose remains eligible for edible_3d_complex regardless of color.
